pairs.notes: B wires both the Start and Pause buttons to the same toggleStartPause function (redundant), the countdown is smaller (72px vs 120px), and the Start/Pause/Reset disabled-state management is absent.

A has all three distinct control buttons with proper disabled states; B merges Start/Pause into one toggle (missing a separate Pause button per spec) and auto-resets at 00:00 without being asked, though B's solid-fill control buttons and colored countdown are aesthetically stronger.

A silently auto-resets after the alert fires (not in spec); B has all buttons correctly separated, a visually distinctive outlined Reset vs filled Start/Pause, and a colored monospace countdown at 96px.

B uses a single cycling mode button instead of two dedicated mode buttons and collapses Start/Pause into one toggle, missing the spec's three-button control layout; A correctly disables mode buttons while running and has all required buttons.

B has no media query, so the countdown and buttons do not adapt at mobile widths, violating the spec; A uses a 120px countdown with a subtle glow, disables mode buttons while running, and handles mobile with a proper breakpoint.
